official.deadline_note: Applications for the 2027 intake opened on 1 September 2026 and close 15 March 2027. Selection runs March to June, outcomes are received by June, and the award ceremony is in August.
official.application_cycle: 2027 intake; applications open from 1 September 2026 to 15 March 2027
official.status_note: Official page states 'Applications are open now till 15 March 2027!' (MHA Civilian Scholarship page last updated 1 September 2026).
official.tuition_coverage_note: Tuition fees and other approved charges are covered; the MHA scholarships information booklet describes this as 'Tuition and compulsory fees for undergraduate studies in a range of disciplines'.
benefits: Tuition fees and other approved charges
Monthly overseas or local maintenance allowance (including accommodation)
Pre-studies allowance e.g. settling in, warm clothing, computer
Return economy class airfare (for selected scholarship tiers)
Sponsorship of Master's and exchange programmes (if requirements are met)
Full salary for the duration of studies including bonuses (mid-term scholars, for selected scholarship tiers)
Placement on the Home Team Leaders-in Development Programme and possible emplacement on the Public Service Leadership Programme where criteria are met
eligibility: Singapore Citizen or Singapore Permanent Resident who is intending to take up Singapore Citizenship
Have strong leadership qualities and potential
Possess strong interest in safeguarding the safety and security of Singapore
Have good academic and Co-Curricular Activities (CCAs) records
Have a GCE A-Levels, International Baccalaureate, Polytechnic, NUS High School, or other high school diploma/certificate
Current undergraduate students (not in final year of studies) may also apply for the mid-term scholarship
requirements: Study at a local or overseas university in most disciplines, except medicine, dentistry and architecture
Applicants intending to pursue a degree in Law will not be called to the Bar while serving in the Home Team
Indicate preferred career track (Generalist or Specialist) at the point of interview
Changing specialisation or converting from Civilian to Uniformed scheme requires strong justification and MHA considers each appeal on a case-by-case basis

Mid-term applicants: be pursuing full-time undergraduate studies, on track for graduation with at least 2nd Upper Honours or equivalent, and have completed at least 1 semester without being in the final year
documents: Secondary 4 / Year 4 Year End School Academic Reports (including results and teachers' comments)
Secondary 4 / Year 4 Co-curricular Activities (CCA) and Community Involvement Programme (CIP) records

Certificates of Academic Qualification Obtained (e.g. GCE O-level, GCE A-level, International Baccalaureate Diploma, NUS High School Diploma, Polytechnic Diploma, other high school diploma or equivalent); preliminary examination results are not required

Mid-term applicants additionally: University Academic Transcripts, University CCA Records, Employment Testimonials (if applicable), NS Certificate of Service and Testimonial (if applicable), Public Service Internship Testimonials (if applicable)
Accompanying essay submitted together with the application form
Valid Singpass account for portal login
selection_criteria: Good academic and Co-Curricular Activities (CCAs) records
Strong interest in safeguarding the safety and security of Singapore
Psychometric assessments (general, verbal and numerical reasoning), game-based assessments and psychological interview for shortlisted candidates
Board interview with a panel of senior officers from various Home Team agencies
Offer conditions: medical clearance, security clearance, good NS performance (for male applicants) and university placement
coverage: Tuition fees and other approved charges
Monthly overseas or local maintenance allowance (including accommodation)
Pre-studies allowance e.g. settling in, warm clothing, computer
Return economy class airfare (for selected scholarship tiers)
Sponsorship of Master's and exchange programmes (if requirements are met)
Full salary during studies for mid-term scholars (for selected scholarship tiers)
application_method: Apply through the 'Apply Now' link on the MHA Civilian Scholarship page, which directs to the Public Service Commission scholarship application portal

Log in with Singpass and complete the online application form sections: Personal & Family Details, Education History, Achievements, Career and Course Preferences, University Applications, Other Details, Declaration
Submit the accompanying essay and upload all supporting documents; the application is only complete when the form, essay and all documents are submitted
Receive a video interview link within 7 days of successful submission and complete the video interview
official.application_route: Online via the Public Service Commission scholarship portal (psc.gov.sg) using Singpass; submit the application form, essay and supporting documents, then complete the video interview sent within 7 days.
official.study_mode: Full-time undergraduate studies; mid-term applicants must be pursuing full-time undergraduate studies
official.citizenship_residency: Singapore Citizen or Singapore Permanent Resident who is intending to take up Singapore Citizenship
official.international_eligibility: Not open to international students; restricted to Singapore Citizens and Singapore Permanent Residents intending to take up Singapore Citizenship
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Most disciplines except medicine, dentistry and architecture; Specialist tracks (Commercial Affairs, Intelligence, Internal Security, Psychology) require the relevant discipline; Law degree holders will not be called to the Bar while serving in the Home Team
official.duration: Full-time undergraduate degree at a local or overseas university; bond of 4 years for local studies, 5 years for studies in non-English speaking countries and 6 years for studies in English speaking countries, starting on the day recipients assume official duty after completing their studies
official.description: The Ministry of Home Affairs Civilian Scholarship is awarded to all-rounded individuals who are passionate about strengthening Singapore's safety and security in a civilian appointment. Depending on your interests and aspirations, you can choose from a range of meaningful and rewarding career options as a Generalist or Specialist (Commercial Affairs, Intelligence, Internal Security, Psychology), and kickstart your leadership journey in the Home Team.
official.program_type: Civilian public service undergraduate scholarship with Generalist and Specialist tracks (Commercial Affairs, Intelligence, Internal Security, Psychology)

verification.notes: Award value is published only in qualitative terms (tuition and approved charges, monthly overseas/local maintenance allowance including accommodation, pre-studies allowance, return economy airfare for selected tiers) on mha.gov.sg and in the MHA scholarships information booklet hosted on the official government file service file.go.gov.sg linked from the MHA scholarships page; no official page publishes a numeric allowance figure or an IELTS/TOEFL requirement. Deadline, bond periods, tiers, eligibility and the PSC application steps are all directly confirmed on mha.gov.sg and psc.gov.sg (pages last updated 1 September 2026 and 20 August 2026).

applicant_utility.summary: MHA funds the full cost of an undergraduate degree locally or overseas — tuition and approved charges plus a monthly maintenance allowance that includes accommodation — in exchange for a Home Team bond of four to six years after graduation. You apply through the Public Service Commission portal with Singpass between September and 15 March, submitting an essay and school records, then clear a video interview, psychometric assessments and a board interview before any offer. The Scholarship Board decides your tier (Singapore Government Scholarship, Local Merit Scholarship or Home Team Local Study Award), and that tier determines whether extras such as return airfare and full salary apply. You will only know your track and tier after interview, so apply to the scholarship rather than to one specific package.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Singapore Citizen or Permanent Resident school leavers with strong academic and CCA records who want a civilian Home Team career in policy, intelligence, internal security, commercial affairs enforcement or psychology.
application_readiness_checklist: Assemble Secondary 4 / Year 4 year-end academic reports with teachers' comments, CCA and CIP records, and qualification certificates before opening the portal, because uploads happen inside the application session
Draft the essay early rather than in the final week before 15 March; MHA's own advice is to start early to leave refining time
Have O-level results, pre-tertiary results (A-level, IB, NUS High or Polytechnic diploma) and university application outcomes ready to key into the form
Male applicants: obtain the NS Certificate of Service and testimonial and keep NS performance clean, as good NS performance is an explicit offer condition
Complete the video interview link that arrives within 7 days of submission as soon as it lands, since shortlisting runs March to June
common_rejection_risks: Incomplete submissions: PSC only counts an application as complete when the form, the essay and all supporting documents are submitted, so partial uploads effectively disqualify you
Mid-term applicants who are not on track for at least 2nd Upper Honours or who have finished fewer than one semester or are in their final year
Weak results in the psychometric, game-based or psychological assessments that gate the board interview
Failing the medical or security clearance that conditions the provisional offer, given MHA describes its checks as stringent
Applying for medicine, dentistry or architecture, which are excluded from all MHA scholarships
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The official pages do not itemise exclusions, but two published limits matter when budgeting: the pre-studies allowance does not apply to mid-term scholarships, and return economy airfare is sponsored only for selected scholarship tiers, so confirm what your awarded tier covers before accepting.
document_audit: Preliminary examination results are explicitly not required and should not be uploaded in place of final certificates

Mid-term applicants need a different document set (university transcripts, university CCA records, employment, NS and Public Service internship testimonials where applicable) — a school-leaver list will be incomplete
Qualification certificates must match the education history keyed into the form, since PSC cross-checks uploads against form entries
The portal is unsupported on mobile devices and tablets, so upload large files from a laptop or desktop connection
alerts: The central deadline is 15 March 2027 and outcomes arrive by June, with the award ceremony in August — align university acceptance deadlines around a June/July provisional offer
Permanent Resident applicants must be intending to take up Singapore Citizenship; treat that intention as a condition, not a formality, before committing to the bond
Bond length escalates with where you study: 4 years local, 5 years non-English-speaking countries, 6 years English-speaking countries, and it starts the day you assume duty after graduation
A Law degree will not lead to a call to the Bar while serving in the Home Team
You indicate your preferred track at interview, and post-award track or scheme changes need strong justification and case-by-case MHA approval
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Apply online at psc.gov.sg with Singpass (form plus essay plus document uploads), complete the video interview link sent within 7 days, then progress through psychometric assessments and the board interview toward a June/July offer.
